body:
## Story Points: 5 | Priority: P0 | Sprint: 2

## Summary
Process vehicle entry: validate ownership, allocate available slot, generate unique ticket, record session.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] POST /api/v1/parking/entry requires JWT
- [ ] Customer can only park their own vehicle (403 if vehicle belongs to another user)
- [ ] Duplicate active session for same vehicle returns 403
- [ ] ticketId format: TKT-YYYYMMDD-NNNNN (unique)
- [ ] Slot allocated and marked OCCUPIED
- [ ] Parking full (no AVAILABLE slot) returns 403 with safe message
- [ ] Preferred slotType respected when specified
- [ ] GET /api/v1/parking/active-session returns authenticated user's current session

## Tests
ParkingControllerTest (entry, duplicate session) + ParkingServiceTest (ownership, full lot)

## Definition of Done
Entry creates parking record in DB; ticket ID unique; duplicate entry blocked; full lot handled.
